title: Is it legal to train AI models on copyrighted books? It’s complicated
summary: Fair use is a carve out of copyright law that allows for the use of copyrighted materials without explicit permission, protecting the ability to comment and iterate on copyrighted works through criticism, parody, education, and other means.
